_comment: NSE/BSE equity-segment trading calendar with per-date verification. 'verified_official' needs evidence_url, checked_on and a circular marked read=true; nothing here is verified_official. The official 2026 circulars were IDENTIFIED (numbers below, from search-result listings of nsearchives.nseindia.com URLs) but could NOT be read: that host is blocked by the build environment's network policy (HTTP 403 on CONNECT). Holiday dates come from broker/fund-house pages that agree with each other plus search snippets of the official circulars' text. Exceptional sessions whose times are not officially confirmed are 'pending_sessions' and are NOT polled (fail closed).

regular_session.note: 09:15-15:30 IST normal session is widely reported; the Muhurat press reports also describe a Closing Auction Session. Not read from an official circular.

holidays.name: Municipal elections closure (reported by some sources as a late addition) - sources conflict: some call it a full trading holiday; an official NSE Clearing circular found only changes the settlement schedule. A past date; treated as closed (fail closed).

pending_sessions.note: Diwali Muhurat session on a Sunday. Press reports a main session 14:20-15:30 IST with pre-open 14:05-14:20 and minute-level differences between reports; the circular (NSE/CMTR/76941) was not read, so the times are NOT used and no polling happens.
